messages:
deploybot: deploybot paused promo v2.14.0 -> prod: parity check failed: SERVICE_AUTH_HMAC encoding mismatch staging vs prod. details: https://deploybot/reports/4089990123 :warning:

tara: can we get a quick root cause?

omar: libauth v1.8 now requires standard base64 with '=' padding. staging secret is standard; prod secret uses base64url ("-","_") and is missing padding. verifier throws.

sre_lee: symptom on canary: 401s and cache rejects. logs: `AuthError: invalid character '-' at pos 8`

ops_rene: options: rollback runtime image, reintroduce compat-shim, or normalize prod secret. Normalizing is low-risk if we have sops CI to record change.

product_kay: product prefers no full rollback. temporary shim + secret normalization acceptable if we document.

tara: propose steps:
1) enable CANARY_ONLY env AUTH_ACCEPT_BASE64URL=true on canary
2) compute normalized secret: `kubectl -n prod get secret service-auth -o jsonpath='{.data.SERVICE_AUTH_HMAC}' | base64 --decode | base64`
3) apply patch via sops pipeline and annotate
4) promote v2.14.0 gradually, remove shim after 24h

sre_lee: abort promo if auth errors >0.5% for 15m or cache errors >1% above baseline. rollback cmd: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/ingress --to-revision=<prev>` and revert sops commit.

ops_rene: I'll stage sops commit now and flip canary toggle for 30m test.

deploybot: deploybot applied canary env AUTH_ACCEPT_BASE64URL=true; monitoring started. image pinned: redwood/runtime:v2.14.0+hotfix

omar: canary 20m: auth errors 0.02%, cache steady. ready to normalize prod secret when approved.

tara: approved. mike will run sops-backed patch and then start 5%->25%->100% promotion. I'll write release note blurb about temporary acceptance and ask integrators to rotate keys.

deploybot: deploybot resumed gradual promo for v2.14.0. monitoring thresholds in place.

product_kay: thanks team — please add rollback contact and runbook after promo completes.
